newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales slow, $68 top - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales slow, $68 top - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 lower, instances $2.00 per cwt lower early. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,900 slaughter steers and 700 heifers; 16,000 head confirmed for the week to date including 10,800 head of formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00.
Confirmed - 3,600 Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
Wk to Date - 16,000 Week Ago - 7,500 Year Ago - None
